jobs.title: Data Science Engineer [AQ-26629]
jobs.description:
Make a profound impact on how millions of people connect with technology globally by shaping the future of marketing intelligence. In this dynamic role, you will design, build, and productionize next-generation machine learning and Generative AI components that directly drive strategic decisions, optimize campaign performance, and unlock novel insights for a world-renowned technology leader.

Aquent is thrilled to partner with a globally recognized technology leader that stands at the forefront of innovation, continuously shaping how millions worldwide interact with technology and digital experiences. This visionary organization is dedicated to pushing boundaries, crafting intuitive products, and delivering unparalleled value to its vast customer base through cutting-edge advancements in artificial intelligence and data science. By joining forces with Aquent, you will gain access to an extraordinary opportunity to bring innovative concepts to life, from ideation to seamless deployment, and contribute to products that are truly at the leading edge.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a visionary professional eager to drive significant business impact by building advanced intelligence products. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional analytics experts to refine modeling approaches, manage the full model lifecycle, and serve as a primary technical resource. This is an unparalleled opportunity to work with cutting-edge AI infrastructure, build intelligent agents, and develop sophisticated forecasting models that redefine industry standards.

What You’ll Do

Design, build, and productionize machine learning and Generative AI components for critical applications such as media planning, campaign estimation, and intelligence products.
Develop sophisticated forecasting, estimation, and marketing response models, including dynamic budget-allocation recommendations informed by response curves and diminishing-returns analysis.
Construct advanced Generative AI components, including intelligent agents, robust retrieval mechanisms, and sophisticated entity resolution systems, implementing rigorous evaluation frameworks to ensure reliable and consistent LLM output.
Independently manage the full model lifecycle, encompassing initial problem framing, meticulous feature engineering, comprehensive model development, thorough validation, deployment as Python services and automated pipelines, and continuous monitoring with strategic retraining.
Collaborate closely with internal analytics experts to refine modeling approaches and rigorously validate results, ensuring accuracy and business relevance.
Serve as a primary point of contact for ML engineering support during business hours.

Required Qualifications

Proven experience in building and deploying machine learning models specifically for marketing use cases, including expertise in time-series forecasting, effort/resource estimation, and advanced media-mix style response curve and diminishing-returns (saturation) modeling.
A strong understanding of core marketing performance concepts such as budget allocation, marginal efficiency, campaign pacing, and incrementality.
Exceptional Python skills, demonstrating proficiency with essential libraries including pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, statsmodels, and at least one forecasting or probabilistic modeling library (e.g., Prophet, PyMC, Stan).
A solid grounding in statistics and experimentation principles, including uncertainty quantification, robust backtesting methodologies, and comprehensive model validation techniques.
Hands-on experience building and operating batch ML pipelines, specifically within Apache Airflow, covering intricate scheduling, efficient backfills, data quality checks, and automated retraining processes.
Demonstrated ability to independently own the full model lifecycle, from initial concept to production deployment, including advanced feature engineering, meticulous model versioning, proactive drift monitoring, and effective retraining feedback loops.
A strong understanding of developing Generative AI components, including expertise in AI infrastructure components, tool design, governed semantic layers, LLM agents, intricate tool-calling workflows, advanced prompt engineering, and structured outputs.
Familiarity with various LLM evaluation frameworks (e.g., creating golden datasets, LLM-as-judge methodologies, and regression testing).
Proficiency with vector databases and embeddings for Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG), and designing entity resolution across diverse systems.
Working knowledge of SQL and practical experience with enterprise-grade data warehouses (e.g., Redshift).
Exceptional communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to clearly articulate complex model assumptions, intricate trade-offs, and actionable results to both highly technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Nice-to-Have Qualifications

Experience developing robust services and APIs in Python.
Proficiency with PySpark for efficient large-scale feature processing.
Practical experience with Bayesian modeling techniques.
Knowledge of advanced optimization techniques and constrained budget allocation strategies.

Client Description

Our client is a global leader in consumer technology, renowned for redefining the intersection of hardware, software, and services. Known for their uncompromising commitment to world-class design and user experience, they create products that have become essential to daily life. You will be joining a team that values craftsmanship and simplicity, working on high-impact projects that reach hundreds of millions of people worldwide.

jobs.title: Software Engineer (Java, Python)
jobs.description:
About the Role

GeoDelphi, Inc. dba Whitespace is seeking a Software Engineer to develop and deliver solutions for its Answers platform. The platform is built around four technology layers: source, engine, analytics, and story. This role is part of the engineering team working in the engine layer to help uncover ground truth and develop tools that address complex questions.

You will work with engineers and developers to design, build, test, and support software solutions, primarily using Java. The ideal candidate is a creative problem solver who values thoughtful development, strong technical design, and high-quality products. This position reports to the VP of Engineering.

This is a 100% remote position. Candidates must be U.S. citizens residing in the contiguous United States and must be employed directly by GeoDelphi, Inc. as W-2 employees. Third-party applications are not accepted.

Key Responsibilities

Research, develop, design, implement, and test software for population simulation.
Work with customers and end users to define project requirements and establish achievable project timelines.
Collaborate with Agile teams to design, develop, test, implement, and support technical solutions using back-end development tools and technologies.
Write well-designed, testable, and efficient code, primarily in Java.
Recommend improvements to established application processes.
Prepare and deliver software component releases.
Provide technical support and consultation on application and infrastructure-related questions.

Required Qualifications

At least 5 years of experience in a software engineering role.
Experience designing, building, scaling, and maintaining production software.
Strong programming skills, with an emphasis on code quality and testability.
Experience using programming languages such as Java and Python.
Strong understanding of DevOps and software/application development processes.
Experience with continuous integration and software configuration management processes and tools, including GitLab, JIRA, Confluence, Jenkins, Nexus, or other DevOps and continuous integration tools.
Experience working with SQL and NoSQL databases, including query optimization.
Experience gathering client requirements and resolving workflow challenges through automation and process optimization.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with population simulation or other forms of data simulation.
Experience in geospatial engineering.
Familiarity with big data processing tools such as Spark, Hadoop, Google BigQuery, AWS Athena, and EMR.
Experience working with public cloud platforms such as AWS, Google Cloud, or Microsoft Azure.
Strong data visualization skills.

Location & Work Arrangement

Remote position, with the role based in Alexandria, Virginia.
100% remote within the contiguous United States.
Candidates must be U.S. citizens.
Employment must be directly through GeoDelphi, Inc. on a W-2 basis; third-party applications are not accepted.
Active TS/SCI clearance or eligibility to obtain clearance is required.

Benefits

Medical, dental, and vision insurance plans.
Unlimited paid time off.
Paid federal holidays.
12 weeks of paid parental leave.
Employer-paid short-term and long-term disability insurance.
Employer-paid life insurance.
401(k) plan with employer match.
Professional development assistance.
Equity incentive plan.

Show more

Show less

Seniority level

Associate

Employment type

Full-time

Industries

Technology, Information and Internet
